metadata.title: refactor(tests): move scan-style tests to pre-commit hooks and optimize slow tests
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Moves scan-style tests (AST parsing, source pattern matching, file structure checks) out of pytest into 10 standalone pre-commit hook scripts in `scripts/pre-commit/`. These are code policy checks, not behavioral tests, and don't belong in the test suite.
- Generalizes migration pattern checks (DateTime timezone, SQLAlchemy types, balanced indexes, Boolean defaults) to run against all migrations instead of hardcoded file hashes. Adds migration filename and revision hash validation.
- Marks all stdio subprocess plugin tests `@pytest.mark.slow` consistently and reduces unnecessary `asyncio.sleep` durations in inflight cleanup tests (2s→0.5s, 5s→0.5s).

## Test plan

- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes for all non-migration hooks (migration hook correctly flags pre-existing naming violations in unchanged files)
- [ ] `uv run python -m pytest tests/security/test_input_validation.py::TestSensitiveLoggingRegressions` passes
- [ ] `uv run python -m pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/middleware/test_rbac_endpoint_coverage.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/middleware/test_rbac_admin_bypass.py` passes
- [ ] `uv run python -m pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/db/test_token_uniqueness_migration.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/db/test_observability_migrations.py` passes
- [ ] `uv run python -m pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/framework/test_tenant_plugin_manager_tool_scoped.py::test_factory_reload_inflight_cleanup` completes in <1s (was >2s)
- [ ] CI pytest suite passes with reduced test count (5 deleted test files, scan tests removed from 9 others)

commits.message:
refactor(tests): move scan-style tests to pre-commit hooks and optimize slow tests

Scan-style tests that perform static code analysis (AST parsing, source
pattern matching, file structure checks) don't belong in pytest — they're
code policy checks, not behavioral tests. This moves them to standalone
scripts in scripts/pre-commit/ wired into .pre-commit-config.yaml.

New pre-commit hooks:
- check_sensitive_logging: sensitive var interpolation in logger calls
- check_framework_imports: plugin framework import isolation
- check_machine_paths: reject hardcoded machine-specific paths
- check_no_os_system: no os module in run_mutmut.py
- check_rbac_decorators: permission decorator and bypass coverage
- check_migration_patterns: migration naming, hashes, and universal patterns
- check_rust_workspace: Cargo.toml inheritance and workspace layout
- check_ci_workflows: SHA pinning and workflow structure
- check_logo_assets: asset reference integrity
- check_source_patterns: cross-module code invariants

Test speed improvements:
- Mark all stdio subprocess tests @pytest.mark.slow consistently
- Reduce asyncio.sleep in inflight cleanup tests (2s→0.5s, 5s→0.5s)

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
